The module implements a state machine to manage three states: waiting for the readiness of the receiver, transferring the data and validity signals, and waiting for the second clock signal to complete the transaction. The module also handles synchronous reset functionality for both clock domains, ensuring proper initialization and operation.

    input clk1,
    input rst1,
    input data1,
    input valid1,
    output reg ready1,

    input clk1,
    input rst1,
    input data1,
    input valid1,
    output reg ready1,
    input clk2,
    input rst2,
    output reg data2,
    output reg valid2,
    input ready2
);reg [1:0] state;

always @(posedge clk1, posedge rst1) begin
    if (rst1) begin
        state <= 2'b0;
        ready1 <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        case (state)
            2'b00: begin // wait for ready2
                if (ready2) begin
                    state <= 2'b01;
                    ready1 <= 1'b1;
                end
            end
            2'b01: begin // transfer data1 to data2
                data2 <= data1;
                valid2 <= valid1;
                state <= 2'b10;
            end
            2'b10: begin // wait for clk2
                if (clk2) begin
                    state <= 2'b00;
                    ready1 <= 1'b0;
                end
            end
        endcase
    end
end

always @(posedge clk2, posedge rst2) begin
    if (rst2) begin
        data2 <= 1'b0;
        valid2 <= 1'b0;
    end else begin
        if (valid2 && ready2) begin

        end else if (!valid2 && ready2) begin
